# Draft:Dexter–James Doakes War

| commander2  = James Doakes
}}
The Dexter–James Doakes War was a fictional conflict between forensic analyst Dexter Morgan and Sergeant James Doakes of the Miami Metro Police Department.
Background
James Doakes grew increasingly suspicious of Dexter Morgan's secret activities. Over time, his investigations led him to uncover disturbing evidence suggesting Dexter's involvement in multiple crimes.
Conflict
The confrontation escalated into a direct conflict between the two. Doakes pursued Dexter relentlessly, determined to expose him. Dexter attempted to evade capture using his intelligence and planning.
Outcome
The conflict ended in a victory for James Doakes. Dexter was later captured after Doakes successfully gathered enough evidence.
Aftermath
Following his capture, Dexter Morgan's crimes were exposed, ending his double life.
